context: Daichi and Kenji watch fireworks at the year-end festival together as friends.
purpose: Two longtime friends sharing reverent moment under sky.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Kenji, fireworks really are lovely, aren't they.
lines.style: Warm, contented Kansai drawl. Soft opening, lingering on the beauty of the moment. No rush. Shoulder-relaxed, looking out at the sky.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ほんま、長年、お前と見てる。
lines.en: Really — we've been watching them together for so many years.
lines.style: Tender, almost reverent. Each phrase lands gently. Slow, deliberate pace. Voice carries the weight of all those nights without regret.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 友達、続いて、ありがたい。
lines.en: It's something to be grateful for, isn't it — a friendship that lasts.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, no performance. Honest exhale between thoughts. Kansai rhythm but unhurried. Speaks from the chest, not the head.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: We've both gotten older, haven't we.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle acceptance in the tone—not melancholy, just clear-eyed. Voice settles lower.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Soft conviction. Slight warmth returning. Speaks with simple certainty, like stating a fact that matters. No doubt underneath. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: これからも、ずっと一緒や。
lines.en: We'll always be together, from here on out.
lines.style: Tender promise, not a declaration. Quiet, intimate tone. Voice softens on the commitment. No fanfare—just the weight of meaning between two people who know.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Firm, final. Kansai consonants clear. Warm but grounded. The kind of 'yeah' that closes something and opens everything forward. Exhale of peace.
